cv.title: Full-Stack Developer
cv.summary: Full-stack developer based in Riyadh. Backend developer on Thouq, a group restaurant-recommendation app and my Holberton capstone project. Background in cybersecurity and governance from government-sector work.

projects.name: Thouq (Holberton capstone, team project)
projects.desc: App that helps a group choose a restaurant: members enter preferences and the group votes on a shortlist. As backend developer I built phone-number login with SMS verification and JWT, a public restaurant listing API over 33,000 restaurants, and the SMS provider integration.

projects.name: Wudhuh (wudhuh.com)
projects.desc: Arabic-first web app that sorts a person's thoughts into categories and urgency levels. Built and published it, including authentication, per-user storage with row-level security, and rate limiting.
projects.stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Upstash Redis, Vercel

projects.name: Stocks Advisor
projects.desc: Question-answering system over a library of investing texts, built with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): ingestion scripts, vector search, and answers grounded in the retrieved passages.
